verses.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verses.pt: Poderás tirar com anzol o leviatã, ou apertar-lhe a língua com uma corda?
verses.en_web: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.en_bbe: Is it possible for Leviathan to be pulled out with a fish-hook, or for a hook to be put through the bone of his mouth?

verses.en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.pt: Poderás meter-lhe uma corda de junco no nariz, ou com um gancho furar a sua queixada?
verses.en_web: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
verses.en_bbe: Will you put a cord into his nose, or take him away with a cord round his tongue?

verses.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.pt: Porventura te fará muitas súplicas, ou brandamente te falará?
verses.en_web: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
verses.en_bbe: Will he make prayers to you, or say soft words to you?

verses.en: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.pt: Fará ele aliança contigo, ou o tomarás tu por servo para sempre?
verses.en_web: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
verses.en_bbe: Will he make an agreement with you, so that you may take him as a servant for ever?

verses.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.pt: Brincarás com ele, como se fora um pássaro, ou o prenderás para tuas meninas?
verses.en_web: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
verses.en_bbe: Will you make sport with him, as with a bird? or put him in chains for your young women?

verses.en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.pt: Farão os sócios de pesca tráfico dele, ou o dividirão entre os negociantes?
verses.en_web: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
verses.en_bbe: Will the fishermen make profit out of him? will they have him cut up for the traders?

verses.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.pt: Poderás encher-lhe a pele de arpões, ou a cabeça de fisgas?
verses.en_web: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
verses.en_bbe: Will you put sharp-pointed irons into his skin, or fish-spears into his head?

verses.en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.pt: Põe a tua mão sobre ele; lembra-te da peleja; nunca mais o farás!
verses.en_web: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
verses.en_bbe: Only put your hand on him, and see what a fight you will have; you will not do it again!

verses.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.pt: Eis que é vã a esperança de apanhá-lo; pois não será um homem derrubado só ao vê-lo?
verses.en_web: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.en_bbe: Truly, the hope of his attacker is false; he is overcome even on seeing him!

verses.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.pt: Ninguém há tão ousado, que se atreva a despertá-lo; quem, pois, é aquele que pode erguer-se diante de mim?
verses.en_web: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
verses.en_bbe: He is so cruel that no one is ready to go against him. Who then is able to keep his place before me?

verses.en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.pt: Quem primeiro me deu a mim, para que eu haja de retribuir-lhe? Pois tudo quanto existe debaixo de todo céu é meu.
verses.en_web: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
verses.en_bbe: Who ever went against me, and got the better of me? There is no one under heaven!

verses.en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.pt: Não me calarei a respeito dos seus membros, nem da sua grande força, nem da graça da sua estrutura.
verses.en_web: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
verses.en_bbe: I will not keep quiet about the parts of his body, or about his power, and the strength of his frame.

verses.en: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
verses.pt: Quem lhe pode tirar o vestido exterior? Quem lhe penetrará a couraça dupla?
verses.en_web: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?
verses.en_bbe: Who has ever taken off his outer skin? who may come inside his inner coat of iron?

verses.en: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.pt: Quem jamais abriu as portas do seu rosto? Pois em roda dos seus dentes está o terror.
verses.en_web: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
verses.en_bbe: Who has made open the doors of his face? Fear is round about his teeth.

verses.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.pt: As suas fortes escamas são o seu orgulho, cada uma fechada como por um selo apertado.
verses.en_web: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
verses.en_bbe: His back is made of lines of plates, joined tight together, one against the other, like a stamp.

verses.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.pt: Uma à outra se chega tão perto, que nem o ar passa por entre elas.
verses.en_web: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.en_bbe: One is so near to the other that no air may come between them.

verses.en: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.pt: Umas às outras se ligam; tanto aderem entre si, que não se podem separar.
verses.en_web: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
verses.en_bbe: They take a grip of one another; they are joined together, so that they may not be parted.

verses.en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.pt: Os seus espirros fazem resplandecer a luz, e os seus olhos são como as pestanas da alva.
verses.en_web: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.en_bbe: His sneezings give out flames, and his eyes are like the eyes of the dawn.

verses.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.pt: Da sua boca saem tochas; faíscas de fogo saltam dela.
verses.en_web: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
verses.en_bbe: Out of his mouth go burning lights, and flames of fire are jumping up.

verses.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.pt: Dos seus narizes procede fumaça, como de uma panela que ferve, e de juncos que ardem.
verses.en_web: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
verses.en_bbe: Smoke comes out of his nose, like a pot boiling on the fire.

verses.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.pt: O seu hálito faz incender os carvões, e da sua boca sai uma chama.
verses.en_web: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: His breath puts fire to coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

verses.en: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.pt: No seu pescoço reside a força; e diante dele anda saltando o terror.
verses.en_web: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
verses.en_bbe: Strength is in his neck, and fear goes dancing before him.

verses.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.pt: Os tecidos da sua carne estão pegados entre si; ela é firme sobre ele, não se pode mover.
verses.en_web: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
verses.en_bbe: The plates of his flesh are joined together, fixed, and not to be moved.

verses.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
verses.pt: O seu coração é firme como uma pedra; sim, firme como a pedra inferior dumá mó.
verses.en_web: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
verses.en_bbe: His heart is as strong as a stone, hard as the lower crushing-stone.

verses.en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.pt: Quando ele se levanta, os valentes são atemorizados, e por causa da consternação ficam fora de si.
verses.en_web: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
verses.en_bbe: When he gets ready for the fight, the strong are overcome with fear.

verses.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.pt: Se alguém o atacar com a espada, essa não poderá penetrar; nem tampouco a lança, nem o dardo, nem o arpão.
verses.en_web: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
verses.en_bbe: The sword may come near him but is not able to go through him; the spear, or the arrow, or the sharp-pointed iron.

verses.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.pt: Ele considera o ferro como palha, e o bronze como pau podre.
verses.en_web: He counts iron as straw; and brass as rotten wood.
verses.en_bbe: Iron is to him as dry grass, and brass as soft wood.

verses.en: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.pt: A seta não o poderá fazer fugir; para ele as pedras das fundas se tornam em restolho.
verses.en_web: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
verses.en_bbe: The arrow is not able to put him to flight: stones are no more to him than dry stems.

verses.en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.pt: Os bastões são reputados como juncos, e ele se ri do brandir da lança.
verses.en_web: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
verses.en_bbe: A thick stick is no better than a leaf of grass, and he makes sport of the onrush of the spear.

verses.en: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.pt: Debaixo do seu ventre há pontas agudas; ele se estende como um trilho sobre o lodo.
verses.en_web: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
verses.en_bbe: Under him are sharp edges of broken pots: as if he was pulling a grain-crushing instrument over the wet earth.

verses.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.pt: As profundezas faz ferver, como uma panela; torna o mar como uma vasilha de ungüento.
verses.en_web: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.en_bbe: The deep is boiling like a pot of spices, and the sea like a perfume-vessel.

verses.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.pt: Após si deixa uma vereda luminosa; parece o abismo tornado em brancura de cãs.
verses.en_web: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
verses.en_bbe: After him his way is shining, so that the deep seems white.

verses.en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.pt: Na terra não há coisa que se lhe possa comparar; pois foi feito para estar sem pavor.
verses.en_web: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
verses.en_bbe: On earth there is not another like him, who is made without fear.

verses.en: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.pt: Ele vê tudo o que é alto; é rei sobre todos os filhos da soberba.
verses.en_web: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
verses.en_bbe: Everything which is high goes in fear of him; he is king over all the sons of pride.
